final: WITH account_totals AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 as region, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE -t.amount END), 0) as account_total, COALESCE(COUNT(t.trans_id), 0) as transaction_count FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), region_totals AS (SELECT region, SUM(account_total) as region_total FROM account_totals GROUP BY region) SELECT at.account_id, at.region, at.account_total, at.transaction_count, CASE WHEN rt.region_total != 0 THEN at.account_total * 1.0 / rt.region_total ELSE NULL END as share FROM account_totals at JOIN region_totals rt ON at.region = rt.region ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
